# externals/

Third-party Max externals bundled with the project.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `o.route.mxe64` | CNMAT odot `o.route`, **Windows build only**. Splits the incoming OSC bundle by `/synaptic/...` address. |

The patch also uses `o.display` (odot), which is **not** bundled. Install the **odot** package from the Max Package Manager. See [issue #2](https://github.com/AhUhmm/synaptic/issues/2).
